children: Stride reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results for the period ended September 30, 2026, with revenue of $639.4 million and income from operations of $84.3 million. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $64.9 million, and adjusted diluted earnings per share were $1.37. The company provided full-year 2027 guidance including revenue of $2.53–2.61 billion and adjusted operating income of $500–530 million.
Revenue: $639.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, up from $620.9 million a year earlier.
Gross profit: $241.1 million for the quarter (gross margin figure presented as gross profit in the filing).
Income from operations: $84.3 million for the quarter, compared with $69.0 million in Q1 FY2026.
Net income attributable to common stockholders: $64.9 million for the quarter; diluted net income per share: $1.45.
Adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP): $1.37 for the quarter; adjusted EBITDA: $111.8 million.
Total average enrollments for the quarter were 241.4K, a (2.5)% decline year-over-year; Career Learning enrollments increased to 112.2K, up 2.0%.

Revenue per enrollment increased: overall revenue per enrollment was $2,556 (up 7.0%); General Education revenue per enrollment was $2,670 (up 5.0%); Career Learning revenue per enrollment was $2,425 (up 10.4%).
Segment performance shift toward Career Learning: Career Learning revenues rose 9.7% year-over-year driven by Middle–High School growth, while General Education declined 1.8%.
Capital deployment: capital expenditures for the quarter were $24.5 million, primarily capitalized software ($17.9M) and curriculum development ($6.6M).

Liquidity and balance sheet activity: cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $884.2 million as of September 30, 2026, and accounts receivable increased reflecting timing and mix changes.
